name: User Management
description: Manage users using the Users interface, including creation, modification, deletion, sorting, column reordering, and multiple selection.
preconditions: The main application window is displayed.
At least two users are present in the users table.
goal: In the Users section, create a new user named 'testuser' by selecting the specified role and Enabled state. Change the Enabled state of a user, edit a user's name to 'editeduser', and delete the newly created 'testuser' using the contextual menu. Reorder the table columns by dragging a column header to a new position and sort the table content by clicking a column header. Finally, select multiple users in the table simultaneously.
success_criteria: A new user has been created with the specified name.
The specified role has been selected for the new user.
The Enabled state of the new user has been set as specified.
The Enabled state of a user has been changed.
A user's name has been edited successfully.
The newly created user has been deleted using the contextual menu.
A table column has been reordered by dragging its header.
The table content has been sorted by clicking a column header.
Multiple users have been selected simultaneously.
